verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs describe after-response scripting, automated testing across collection requests, importing tests from Postman, and running API tests in CI via Inso CLI with pass/fail exit codes. Together these imply a scriptable test layer, but none of the evidence explicitly shows assertions on response status, body, or headers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an assertion API (e.g. expect/test functions), concrete examples of status/body/header checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
